claim: Pierre Combet, FL's VP Real Estate EMEA (Amsterdam), wrote on his 5-year anniversary that the pan-European portfolio was 'nearly 800 stores' when he joined in Jan 2021, that his tenure brought 'tough decisions, portfolio resets', and that after the DKS acquisition he is 'still checking each deal and lease clause more closely than ever'.
data_point: ~800 European stores Jan 2021 (incl. legacy Sidestep/Runners Point) vs 559 owned at 8/1/26
original_quote: manage a pan-European real estate portfolio of then nearly 800 stores ... tough decisions, portfolio resets ... still checking each deal and lease clause more closely than ever
verifier_note: Post fetched; all four quoted phrases present verbatim, plus 'We were acquired in September by DICK'S Sporting Goods'. Activity ID decodes to 2026-01-11 14:21 UTC. Not in baseline or other confirmed files (A_w1_company-side-new covers Combet's Fast Break/ArenA posts, not this one). Caveats: the ~800 figure includes the Sidestep (~78) and Runners Point banners wound down pre-deal, so the scraper's '~30% shrink, ~6%/yr' overstates the like-for-like FL-banner decline; 'checking lease clauses' is soft language that reads as cost discipline, not an announced exit.

claim: Store locators lag real closures. FL Mannheim Planken O7,13 shut after fire damage (reported 26 Jun 2025) and was still listed as an empty unit in Mannheimer Morgen's 1 Jul 2026 retail round-up, yet the live stores.footlocker.de page still shows normal hours. Liège Vinâve d'Île 30 (Sudinfo, 25 Apr 2023: FL leaving Liège city centre after 20 years) is also still live on stores.footlocker.be with hours.
data_point: At least 2 closed stores still listed live on the FL locator (DE 1, BE 1); Mannheim vacant ~12 months after the fire
original_quote: Dagegen stehen weiterhin einige Läden leer. Das gilt etwa für beide ehemaligen Schuh-Görtz-Filialen in P4 und P6, für Foot Locker in P7 ...
english_translation: Several shops remain empty, for example both former Görtz branches in P4 and P6, Foot Locker in P7 ...
verifier_note: Both Mannheimer Morgen articles return 403 (paywall/bot block), so the Foot Locker sentences were NOT read directly. Google News RSS confirms the articles exist: 'Einzelhandel in Mannheim: Die Lücken auf den Planken werden größer' (2025-06-26) and 'Nach Aus für Zalando und Depot: Weitere Veränderungen im Mannheimer City-Handel' dated 2026-07-01. The scraper's '2026-01-07' is a day/month swap, so the vacancy is ~12 months after the fire, not ~6. Live locator pages checked 2026-10-07: Mannheim Planken O7.13 shows Mon-Sat 10-20 with no closure notice; Liège Vinâve d'Ile 30 (ID 02113) is in the BE sitemap with hours. Sudinfo blocked the fetch; the 2023 closure rests on its URL slug ('le-magasin-foot-locker-quitte-le-centre-ville-de-liege-apres-20-annees'). Also, Liège Quai des Vennes (Belle-Île), which D_w1_chatter flags closed, is still in the BE sitemap. Mannheim is a fire-driven pre-deal closure, not a DKS decision. Its value is the caveat: live-locator counts (e.g. B_w1_registry-dach DE 82) overstate the open fleet.
